Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the salon-add-dialog and Manual Invoice dialogs to remove Radix a11y warnings.
daily_sales_range calls daily_sales(day=..., current_user=...) in a loop — O(N) DB queries. Fine for ≤90 days but could aggregate in a single Mongo pipeline for perf.
